title: Expand affected-scope selection beyond the Rust closure
objective: Implement repository step 9 only: deterministic fail-closed affected-scope ownership and workflow selection for contracts, Protobuf/API compatibility, migrations, PostgreSQL/process acceptance, product plane, frontend and operations, with full-workspace Rust fallback for shared impact and a hard fail when unknown non-Rust workflow closure cannot be proven.
deliverables: publish one authoritative affected-scope policy with exact owners for eight repository-step-9 categories
select cumulative contract, Protobuf/API, migration, PostgreSQL, process/runtime, product, frontend and operations scopes deterministically
require permanent workflows for every selected non-Rust scope and fail closed on missing workflow inventory
align Product Plane and Rust Generated Sync path filters with every governed Protobuf/API compatibility input
broaden shared impact to the full Rust workspace; fail closed for unknown ownership or a known scope under-covered by real workflow path filters
emit deterministic machine-readable and Markdown explanations with safe skip reasons
integrate the same analyzer into packet-check and permanent read-only Affected Scope CI
add permanent fixture and live-repository coverage for ownership, workflow gaps, cumulative scopes and broad fallback
acceptance: all eight repository-step-9 scope categories have one explicit policy owner and non-empty path/workflow rules
known category changes retain every mandatory permanent workflow; missing or under-covered workflow selection fails closed
representative paths from every policy category pass against the repository's actual permanent pull-request filters
missing mandatory workflow inventory fails before packet acceptance
shared CI-policy changes broaden Rust validation; unknown non-package ownership blocks until explicitly classified
Rust reverse closure remains deterministic and unchanged for ordinary package-owned paths
packet-check consumes the same fail-closed affected-scope report
no product behavior, runtime route, worker, contract, migration, crate, dependency, Cargo.lock or workspace-package change
non_goals: change Customer Privacy runtime or public inventory
implement access/export assembly or owner-specific destructive behavior
add crates, dependencies, manifests, contracts, migrations or Cargo.lock changes
implement local lifecycle commands, worker conformance, frontend features or operations product evidence
start repository step 10 or later work
